output.narrative: 分享故事时，孩子需要老师的提示，在这样的支持下参与讲述。
During small-group time in December, the child confidently shares a story in Chinese. This offers a clear glimpse of the child's confident participation in storytelling with the small group.
这学期，孩子表达的内容和分享的对象有所拓展。学期初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字；后来，能向两位朋友讲述周末发生的事。到了六月，孩子开始讲述时需要老师提醒，随后能在全班面前分享一段故事。从介绍自己到分享生活经历和故事，这些活动呈现了孩子在不同交流情境中的表达。

In March, the child told a short story to the class without a prompt. In the last two whole-class sharing sessions in June, the child needed prompting to begin and stopped after one sentence. These recent sessions show that support to begin sharing remains part of the child's current participation, with the spoken contribution limited to one sentence on both occasions.
这一年，孩子的表达内容与分享对象逐渐拓展。年初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字；四月，能用短句向两位朋友讲述周末的事情。这些分享从介绍自己延伸到讲述生活经历。到了十二月，孩子能自信地在全班面前讲述一段故事，展现了面向更大群体分享故事的能力，也让我们看到了孩子在讲述内容和交流范围上的发展。

During shared block play with two classmates, the child first needed the teacher to model a request, then used the suggested phrase after a verbal reminder. In one May activity, the child requested a block without prompting and participated energetically, carrying blocks and suggesting ideas for a bridge. In the last three activities, teacher reminders supported requests for a turn; no unprompted request was recorded. Reminders to wait until a peer finished speaking were also needed. Within this support, the child contributed ideas to the shared construction.
在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字。在全班面前讲述故事时，孩子开始讲述时需要提示，并能在这样的支持下参与故事分享。这些观察呈现了孩子介绍自己和面向全班讲述故事的表现。
With picture prompts, the child shares a short story with classmates. The pictures form part of the support for the child's storytelling in this June observation.

The child's sharing has expanded from one- or two-word answers to direct teacher questions in small-group picture discussions. With teacher questions, the child later described characters' actions in short sentences with two classmates. In May, a drawing and a reminder to begin supported a confident account of seeing ducks and playing on a slide at the park. In the two most recent class sharing sessions, the child used a drawing and a reminder to begin to recount a personal experience in three or four sentences, and answered one peer follow-up question with a teacher prompt.

The child's spoken contributions have expanded across the semester's observations. In January, prompting supported single-word answers. In March, the child used short sentences to describe a picture with prompting. By April, picture prompts supported telling a short story to the class. These examples show a change in the length and scope of the child's expression, from a word in response to a prompt to sharing a short story with the class, with the recorded supports remaining part of each activity.

In small-group number activities, teacher prompting supported the child in matching numerals to counters, with the range expanding from 1–3 to 1–6. During a shop activity, the child selected a numeral card from 1–6 and counted out the matching toy fruits with a reminder to touch each fruit once. In the last two small-group counting activities, the same reminder supported counting groups of up to eight objects. With teacher guidance, the child also checked which of two groups had more by placing the objects side by side.

output.narrative: With a teacher reminder to touch each counter, the child counts eight counters. This June observation captures the child's counting with that support in place.
这一年，孩子的分享内容和交流范围有所拓展。年初，在老师提示下，孩子能说出自己的名字；四月至六月，能向两位熟悉的朋友讲述一件事情。七月至九月，孩子在小组活动中借助图片提示讲述故事。进入十月至十二月，孩子开始讲述时仍需要老师提醒，并能在全班面前讲述一段故事。这些分享呈现了孩子从介绍自己到讲述事情和故事、从与朋友交流到面向全班表达的发展。
在与同伴轮流使用积木的交流中，孩子的请求方式有了新的表现。二月，孩子在老师逐句提示下，向同伴提出轮流使用的请求。六月的一次积木活动中，孩子没有老师提示，便向同伴提出了同样的请求。这一次主动表达，呈现了孩子在轮流使用积木时尝试自行提出请求的表现。

Across the year, the child has counted larger groups of counters with a teacher reminder to touch each counter once. Early in the year, the child counted groups of three; from April to June, the groups contained six. From July to September, the child counted nine counters, and the October to December observations record groups of twelve. The reminder to touch each counter once remains part of the activity, including the latest December observation. Within this consistent support, the child's counting has expanded to larger groups.
六月的观察呈现了孩子在不同交流情境中的表现。与两位熟悉的朋友交谈时，孩子能清楚地讲故事；在全班面前分享时，孩子需要老师逐句提示。老师逐句提供的支持是孩子参与全班分享时需要的帮助，而与熟悉朋友交谈中的清楚讲述，也呈现了孩子在这一情境下的表达能力。

The child's sharing has grown to include more content and a wider audience. Earlier in the semester, a teacher prompt supported saying the child's own name. By March, the child told two friends about a weekend activity, bringing a personal experience into conversation. More recently, with a reminder to begin, the child shared a short story with the class. Together, these observations show an expansion from introducing oneself to sharing experiences and a story, with the June reminder supporting the start of the class sharing.

With teacher prompting, the child matches numerals to groups of objects. The range has expanded from numerals 1 and 2 in February to numerals 1–6 in June. Teacher prompting remains part of the activity as the child works with this wider range of numerals and object groups.
这学期，孩子的中文表达从说出图中动物名称，拓展到描述动作和讲述故事。学期初，在小组看图活动中，老师提问后，孩子能用中文说出动物名称；后来在追问下，用简短中文句子描述小兔子的动作。五月的一次小组活动中，孩子借助三张图片和转折处的两次提示，按顺序讲述小兔子找朋友的故事。最近两次小组故事活动中，孩子借助图片说出开始和结尾，连接中间情节仍需要老师提问提示，也能回应一位同伴关于人物的简单问题。
在小组交流中，孩子四月有一次能等候同伴说完后再发言。六月最近三次小组活动中，孩子每次都需要老师提醒等候同伴说完后再发言。近期的表现呈现了孩子目前参与轮流交流时，仍需要老师提醒等候的支持。
在提示的支持下，孩子能向小组讲述一件事情。这呈现了孩子在小组分享中的表达表现，提示是讲述时所需要的帮助。
十二月的小组活动中，孩子能自信地用中文分享故事。在这一分享情境中，孩子呈现了用中文讲述故事的能力，也展现了参与小组故事分享时的自信。
